description: Update a voice agent. Requires the OWNER or ADMIN role. Send only the fields you want to change; agentId, companyId, and userId are immutable and silently dropped if sent.

agentId.description: ID of the voice agent to update (from list_voice_agents)

avatar.description: Set to attach a video avatar; avatarUrl/provider are derived server-side from the catalog row.

avatarId.description: Must match a row in your company's avatar catalog (list_voice_avatars) or the shared system catalog.

enableWebSearch.description: Let the agent search the web mid-call, separate from any attached knowledge base.

folderId.description: Folder to file this agent's conversations under.

instructions.description: Required on create. The agent's system instructions.

model.description: Must be one of the voice-agent model ids if sent.

provider.description: Must be one of the voice-agent LLM providers if sent.

personality.description: Required on create. Free text describing the agent's tone.

provider.description: TTS provider, e.g. elevenlabs or openai.

name: update_voice_agent

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Update Voice Agent
